narrative.overview: LifeLink Mobile is an Egyptian clinical blood logistics and emergency donor platform connecting hospitals, certified cold-chain couriers, caregivers, and voluntary donors. Its visual atmosphere balances institutional medical authority with reassuring human clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Calm Clinical Authority: Crisp white surfaces framed with whisper borders (#E2E8F0) and diffused ambient shadows.
RTL-Native Ergonomics: Built specifically for Arabic Cairo typography, right-to-left layout flows, and 48x48 dp touch target compliance.
Strict Clinical Contrast: WCAG AA compliant text pairings ensuring high visibility under emergency room harsh lighting.
Evidence-Based Medical Logistics: Reflects authentic Egyptian Blood Bank standards (males 18-60, females 18-40) and official hospital requisition data.

rules.name: The Rarity of Red Rule
rules.body: Medical red is strictly reserved for actionable primary buttons, emergency shortage badges, and critical lab values. Input focus must use Clinical Blue to avoid mimicking an error state.

rules.name: The Native RTL Rule
rules.body: All screen typography and icon orientations must respect Arabic text direction. Directional icons must point along the reading line.

rules.name: The Surface Integrity Rule
rules.body: Cards sit directly on the #F8F9FA background with a crisp 1px border (#E2E8F0) and soft ambient blur; dark heavy shadows are banned.
